name: bokbok
description: bokbok — a tiny retro-pixel chat app

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/vite build && cd .. && node backend/src/server.js
scripts.start: cd backend && sh -c '[ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ] && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss || true' && node src/server.js
